pages.name: Portfolio
pages.storyNote: How much space the portfolio holds, how it is divided, and how many people it serves.

visuals.title: Total area (sq ft)
visuals.altText: Combined floor area of every building in the portfolio.

visuals.title: Zones
visuals.altText: Number of distinct zones across all floors.

visuals.subtext: Area and zone mix set the baseline. HVAC and lighting load only mean something once you know how much space they serve.

visuals.title: Which buildings hold the floor area
visuals.altText: Floor area for each building, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Where the occupancy capacity sits
visuals.altText: Maximum occupancy for each zone type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Which building types hold the most area
visuals.altText: Floor area by building type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Building detail
visuals.altText: Floor and zone count for every building, with its type.

pages.name: Systems & alerts
pages.storyNote: What the building systems draw, and where the alerts and tickets come from.

visuals.title: HVAC capacity (BTU)
visuals.altText: Combined rated capacity of every HVAC system.

visuals.title: Lighting load (W)
visuals.altText: Combined rated wattage of every lighting system.

visuals.title: Critical alerts
visuals.altText: Number of alerts raised at critical severity.

visuals.subtext: Systems with the largest installed load are not always the ones raising alerts. Where the two diverge is worth a site visit.

visuals.title: Which HVAC types carry the load
visuals.altText: Rated HVAC capacity by system type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Which sensor types raise the alerts
visuals.altText: Alert count by sensor type, sorted from most to least.

visuals.title: Where lighting wattage concentrates
visuals.altText: Rated wattage by lighting system type, sorted from largest to smallest.

visuals.title: Who raises the maintenance tickets
visuals.altText: Maintenance ticket count by the access level of the assigned occupant.
